usedFor: HubSpot holds the contacts, and Kylas CRM receives the lead from “Update Contact's Lead Status” through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Update Contact's Lead Status” in HubSpot, then “Create or Update Lead” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: The action updates or skips when the phone or email already exists, so repeated status changes add no duplicates.

watchOut: “Create Contact” needs an email, so a lead from “New Lead Created” without one cannot be added to HubSpot.
